occurrences.source_excerpt: 1,2 Timed Up and Go (TUG) Test 1. Equipment: arm chair, tape measure, tape, stop watch. 2. Begin the test with the subject sitting correctly in a chair with arms, the subject’s back should resting on the back of the chair. The chair should be stableand positioned such that it will not move when the subject moves from sitting to standing. 3. Place a piece of tape or other marker on the floor 3 meters away from the chair so that it is easily seen by the subject. 4. Instructions: “On the word GO yo
